text: I look after a 4 month old boy and I'm scared I'm missing something. He's had a little cough today, nothing big, just the odd cough here and there. And his eczema has flared up badly, dry rough patches on his cheeks and in the creases of his arms and he keeps rubbing his face on me because it's itchy. His parents are away till tomorrow and I'm on my own with him. Is the cough something to worry about at his age? what can I safely put on his skin tonight
